name: revenge-day
description: Step 11 test day, run for three game days (start it at 18:00 on day 1): the brawl-day setup (Tomas, armed with a hammer and provoked, squares up to Kael in the Tilted Cup), then nothing more from the director. Nobody is given an ambition or asked to plan. Watch the nights: does consolidation turn the fight into a revenge ambition (ambition_changes add, with the deed in WHAT WAS DONE TO YOU), does a scheme get planned at reflection or in sleep (or no_plan), does it reach YOUR PLAN with a step falling due (tier scheme_step), and does anyone confide or recruit. Kael is cunning, Tomas is not: the traits are set so the two sides differ.

actions.reason: test day: a drifter who lives on his wits
